description_en: Queries the redirect configuration list of a site
description_zh: 查询站点的重定向配置列表
name: ListRedirectRules

parameters.help_en: The site ID, which can be obtained by calling the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2850189.html operation
parameters.name: site_id

parameters.help_en:
The configuration type. Valid values:
global: global configuration.
rule: rule configuration
parameters.help_zh:
配置类型。取值范围：
global：全局配置。
rule：规则配置
parameters.name: config_type

parameters.help_en: The rule name. You can use this parameter to query the rule whose name matches the specified value
parameters.help_zh: 规则名，可以查出规则名为所传字段的那条规则
parameters.name: rule_name

parameters.help_en: The page number for a paged query. The value must be greater than or equal to 1
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时设置的页码。取值大于等于 1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page for a paged query. Valid values: 1 to 500
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时每页的大小，取值范围 1-500
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The version number of the site configuration. For sites with version management enabled, you can use this parameter to specify the site version for which the configuration takes effect. Default value: 0
parameters.help_zh: 站点配置的版本号。开启了配置版本管理的站点，可以通过该参数指定配置生效的站点版本，默认为版本0
parameters.name: site_version

ConfigType.description_en:
The configuration type. Valid values:
global: global configuration.
rule: rule configuration
ConfigType.description_zh:
配置类型。取值范围：
global：全局配置。
rule：规则配置

ReserveQueryString.description_en:
Specifies whether to preserve the query string. Valid values:
on: enabled.
off: disabled
ReserveQueryString.description_zh:
保留查询字符串。取值范围：
on：开启。
off：关闭

Rule.description_en:
The rule content, which uses a conditional expression to match user requests. You do not need to set this parameter when adding a global configuration. Two scenarios are supported:
Match all incoming requests: set the value to true.
Match specified requests: set the value to a custom expression, for example, (http.host eq \"video.example.com\")
Rule.description_zh:
规则内容，使用条件表达式来匹配用户请求。添加全局配置的时候不需要设置该参数。存在两种使用场景：
匹配所有传入请求：值设置为true
匹配指定请求：值设置为自定义表达式，例如：(http.host eq \"video.example.com\")

RuleEnable.description_en:
The rule switch. You do not need to set this parameter when adding a global configuration. Valid values:
on: enabled.
off: disabled
RuleEnable.description_zh:
规则开关。添加全局配置的时候不需要设置该参数。取值范围：
on：开启。
off：关闭

RuleName.description_en: The rule name. You do not need to set this parameter when adding a global configuration
RuleName.description_zh: 规则名称。添加全局配置的时候不需要设置该参数

Sequence.description_en: The rule execution order. A smaller value indicates a higher priority
Sequence.description_zh: 规则执行顺序。数值越小越优先执行

SiteVersion.description_en: The version number of the site configuration. For sites with version management enabled, you can use this parameter to specify the site version for which the configuration takes effect. Default value: 0
SiteVersion.description_zh: 站点配置的版本号。开启了配置版本管理的站点，可以通过该参数指定配置生效的站点版本，默认为版本0

StatusCode.description_en:
The HTTP status code used when the node responds to the client with the redirect address. Valid values:
301
302
303
307
308
StatusCode.description_zh:
节点给客户端响应重定向地址时候使用的响应状态码。取值范围：
301
302
303
307
308

TargetUrl.description_en: The target URL after the redirect

Type.description_en:
The redirect type. Valid values:

static: static pattern.
dynamic: dynamic schema
Type.description_zh:
重定向类型。取值范围：

static：静态模式。
dynamic：动态模式

PageNumber.description_en: The current page number, which is the same as the PageNumber request parameter
PageNumber.description_zh: 当前页码，同请求参数的 PageNumber

PageSize.description_en: The number of entries per page
